name: Caesar Chicken Bake
ingredients_verbatim: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (6 ounces each)
1/2 cup sour cream or Greek yogurt
why: Verified from source: 581 cal / 9g carb / 32g protein per serving — squarely inside the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band with very low carbs. Oven-baked chicken-breast casserole bound by Caesar dressing, sour cream and cheese (no rice/pasta/bread base), so it is structurally low-carb and weigh-and-divide scalable to 14. Croutons are the only board-absent ingredient (garnish/topping) - flagged for the pricer lane, not dropped.
